verdict.rationale: Stripe Issuing is API-first: cards, cardholders, spending controls, disputes, funding, and even agent-specific ephemeral virtual cards are all documented as API operations, and community evidence confirms teams building entirely on the API. However, some dashboard-only conveniences (physical card design/appearance configuration, guided dispute UX, some Connect platform setup flows) are described primarily through the Dashboard with API as a secondary/parallel path, and there's no independent audit confirming 1:1 parity between UI and API surface area. missing for 10: independent verification of full UI/API parity, explicit API equivalents for all dashboard-guided workflows (e.g., card design/appearance, guided dispute UI), and a published OpenAPI spec (probe found only 404s).
